operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the empty five-site physical activation result as ledger 1283
operations.body: Ledger 1283 closes the physical audit of the unit sieve. Across all 31 nontrivial five-site branch quotients and n=1..24, 372 odd pairs are algebraically Mackey-compatible, but delta_0 descends on zero nontrivial branches, hence zero pairs pass the joint physical gate. The identity quotient is the positive control. Thus the algebraic spectrum remains valid but constructs neither selector descent nor the missing relative-chain pushforward. No build was run.
